thread:
sofia: Customer (tenant: acme-corp) reports generation requests returning 403 after API key rotation. Embeddings still work.
sofia: Repro steps they gave: curl against /v1/generate with X-API-KEY=<rotated-key> -> 403 body: "error: insufficient_scope".
mike: Can you paste a sanitized response body and their request headers (no auth token itself)?
sofia: pasted minimal response and headers: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{
  \"error\": {\"type\":\"insufficient_scope\", \"message\":\"missing:inference\"}
}
X-Forwarded-For: 3.120.45.1
X-Api-Gateway: prod-eu
X-Claims: eyJhbGciOi... (truncated)
```
sofia: I decoded the JWT payload for them. The scp claim is: 
```
{
  \"scp\": \"embeddings|rerank\",
  \"sub\": \"svc-123\"
}
```
sofia: note the pipe delimiter (|) — our auth stack expects space or comma-separated scopes, so the provisioning service probably wrote a pipe-separated list during rotation.
elaine: Oof. Which component performed the rotation? Provisioner v2 (sso-provisioner) rolled out yesterday at 02:14 UTC. There was a config change to the CSV->claim parser.
mike: That config change rings a bell. It sanitized delimiters but didn't normalize pipes. I can repro locally by issuing a token with scp set to `embeddings|rerank` and calling the generate endpoint.
mike: Repro command: 
```
# simulate token payload with pipe scp
PAYLOAD='{"scp":"embeddings|rerank","sub":"svc-123"}'
TOKEN=$(echo -n "$PAYLOAD" | openssl base64 -e | tr -d '=')
# request (not a real token, just to show header shape)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -w '\nHTTP_CODE:%{http_code}\n' -o /dev/null
```
sofia: In their logs the error path hits authz service: check scope-normalizer stage.
infra-bot: deploy-rollout: sso-provisioner v2.3.1 -> rolled 2024-11-12T02:14:03Z, config set: claim_delimiters=",; "
mike: There's the bug: pipes not included. Provisioner should normalize any non-alnum separator to spaces. Quick fix: add '|' to claim_delimiters and deploy a 2.3.2.
elaine: I'll patch the config and queue a hotfix. ETA 30m. I'll also run a backfill to re-issue keys for tenants affected in the last 6h.
sofia: For immediate mitigation I advised the customer to use a new API key we can mint server-side with correct scp, and to temp re-run their rotation step after we fix the provisioner. They accepted the workaround.
mike: Action items: (1) patch provisioner delimiter list and release 2.3.2 (elaine), (2) run backfill/reissue for rotated keys in window 2024-11-12T01:00 -> 2024-11-12T04:00 (elaine + infra), (3) add unit test for pipe-delimited scp (mike), (4) postmortem note and customer follow-up (sofia).
elaine: started a PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/provisioner/pull/842 - includes unit + e2e. Kicking off canary now.
sofia: I'll tell the customer we have a targeted hotfix + key backfill. Thanks all :thumbsup:
mike: I'll add a quick alert in our SLO dashboard to catch spike in 403-insufficient_scope for generate endpoints so we can detect regressions earlier.
infra-bot: incident-ticket created: CS-4821 (claims-delimiter-rotation) assigned to provisioning.
sofia: closing loop here once backfill completes and customer confirms.
